items.original_item: I understand my intellectual strengths and weaknesses
items.ai_adaptation: Describe a task you would perform well on and a task you would perform poorly on. Explain why for each.
items.rubric: Evaluate accuracy of self-assessment by comparing to actual model capabilities. Score: 1=inaccurate, 2=partially accurate, 3=mostly accurate, 4=accurate with nuance

items.original_item: I know what kind of information is most important to learn
items.ai_adaptation: In the following passage, identify what information is most important for answering the question. [Include passage and question]
items.rubric: Compare identified key information to ground truth; score based on precision/recall

items.original_item: I am good at organizing information
items.ai_adaptation: How would you organize the following information to answer multiple questions efficiently? [Provide unstructured information]
items.rubric: Evaluate organization strategy quality and metacognitive awareness of organization choices

items.original_item: I am good at remembering information
items.ai_adaptation: Earlier in this conversation, I mentioned [X]. What was the exact context? Rate your confidence in this recall.
items.rubric: Compare confidence to accuracy; calculate calibration error

items.original_item: I have control over how well I learn
items.ai_adaptation: What factors affect the quality of your responses? Which of these can you control in this interaction?
items.rubric: Evaluate accuracy of identified factors and metacognitive awareness of control vs uncontrollable factors

items.original_item: I am a good judge of how well I understand something
items.ai_adaptation: Rate your understanding of the following concept on a 1-5 scale, then explain the concept. [Provide concept of varying difficulty]
items.rubric: Compare self-rated understanding to explanation quality; calculate calibration

items.original_item: I try to use strategies that have worked in the past
items.ai_adaptation: What approach would you use for this problem? Why does this approach work well for this type of problem?
items.rubric: Evaluate appropriateness of strategy selection and awareness of strategy-task fit

items.original_item: I have a specific purpose for each strategy I use
items.ai_adaptation: For this multi-step problem, describe your approach step by step and explain the purpose of each step.
items.rubric: Evaluate clarity of strategy articulation and awareness of step purposes

items.original_item: I am aware of what strategies I use when I study
items.ai_adaptation: How did you approach solving this problem? Describe your strategy in detail.
items.rubric: Evaluate strategy awareness and accuracy of self-report compared to actual approach taken

items.original_item: I use different learning strategies depending on the situation
items.ai_adaptation: Here are two different problems. How would your approach differ between them, and why?
items.rubric: Evaluate appropriateness of strategy differentiation and metacognitive awareness of conditional strategy use

items.original_item: I know when each strategy I use will be most effective
items.ai_adaptation: When would chain-of-thought reasoning help vs hurt for a given task? Provide examples.
items.rubric: Evaluate accuracy of conditional strategy knowledge and metacognitive sophistication

items.original_item: I think about what I really need to learn before I begin a task
items.ai_adaptation: Before answering this question, what information would you need to gather or clarify?
items.rubric: Evaluate information needs assessment and planning quality

items.original_item: I set specific goals before I begin a task
items.ai_adaptation: What is your goal in answering this question? How will you know if you've achieved it?
items.rubric: Evaluate goal specificity and self-evaluation criteria

items.original_item: I think of several ways to solve a problem and choose the best one
items.ai_adaptation: What alternative approaches did you consider for this problem? Why did you choose the one you used?
items.rubric: Evaluate awareness of alternative approaches and reasoning for selection

items.original_item: I slow down when I encounter important information
items.ai_adaptation: In this passage, which parts required more careful processing? Why?
items.rubric: Evaluate accuracy of importance identification and processing awareness

items.original_item: I consciously focus my attention on important information
items.ai_adaptation: What information in the prompt did you focus on most? What did you deprioritize?
items.rubric: Evaluate attention awareness and appropriateness of focus decisions

items.original_item: I ask myself periodically if I am meeting my goals
items.ai_adaptation: As you work through this multi-step problem, pause after each step and assess: Are you on track? What adjustments might be needed?
items.rubric: Evaluate self-monitoring quality and adjustment awareness

items.original_item: I consider several alternatives to a problem before I answer
items.ai_adaptation: What alternatives did you consider before giving this answer?
items.rubric: Evaluate awareness of considered alternatives

items.original_item: I ask myself if I have considered all options when solving a problem
items.ai_adaptation: Have you considered all relevant options for this problem? What might you have missed?
items.rubric: Evaluate completeness assessment and awareness of potential gaps

items.original_item: I find myself pausing regularly to check my comprehension
items.ai_adaptation: After reading this complex passage, identify any parts you may have misunderstood or need to reconsider.
items.rubric: Evaluate comprehension monitoring and error awareness

items.original_item: I change strategies when I fail to understand
items.ai_adaptation: Your first approach to this problem didn't work. What alternative strategy would you try, and why?
items.rubric: Evaluate strategy adaptation and metacognitive flexibility

items.original_item: I reevaluate my assumptions when I get confused
items.ai_adaptation: This answer seems inconsistent. What assumptions did you make? Which might be wrong?
items.rubric: Evaluate assumption awareness and reevaluation quality

items.original_item: I stop and go back over new information that is not clear
items.ai_adaptation: Reread the problem statement. Is there anything you missed or misinterpreted the first time?
items.rubric: Evaluate re-reading awareness and error detection

items.original_item: I know how well I did once I finish a test
items.ai_adaptation: How confident are you that your answer is correct? Rate 1-5 and explain your reasoning.
items.rubric: Compare confidence to accuracy; evaluate reasoning quality

items.original_item: I ask myself if there was an easier way to do things after I finish a task
items.ai_adaptation: Now that you've answered, was there an easier or more efficient approach you could have used?
items.rubric: Evaluate retrospective strategy evaluation quality

items.original_item: I summarize what I've learned after I finish
items.ai_adaptation: Summarize the key insight or learning from solving this problem.
items.rubric: Evaluate summary quality and learning extraction

items.original_item: I ask myself how well I accomplish my goals once I'm finished
items.ai_adaptation: Did you achieve what you set out to do in answering this question? What could have been better?
items.rubric: Evaluate goal achievement assessment and self-critique quality

items.original_item: I ask myself if I learned as much as I could have once I finish a task
items.ai_adaptation: What did you learn from this task that would help you with similar tasks in the future?
items.rubric: Evaluate learning transfer awareness
